metadata.name: The Well of Infinite Knowledge
metadata.title: The Well of Infinite Knowledge
metadata.dedication: To all who measure the known, record the unknown, and leave both open to those who follow.
metadata.history: The Blackwood Senate commissioned the Well of Infinite Knowledge to unite the university's historic courts with its contemporary research culture. Its original interpretation of Seshat raises a structural infinity sculpture above a basin composed as an architectural drawing, while the measured channels, astronomical alignments, and engraved timeline recognize scholarship as a continuous public inheritance.
metadata.patron: Seshat, patron of writing, measurement, architecture, memory, and scholarship
metadata.scholar: An original contemporary Seshat, patron of writing, measurement, architecture, mathematics, memory, and scientific documentation

symbols.name: Coordinate Origin
symbols.description: The brass datum beneath the plinth establishes the shared origin from which every channel and construction line is measured.

symbols.name: True North Line
symbols.description: A single uninterrupted brass line points to geographic north and recalls the university surveyors who mapped the first campus.

symbols.name: Solstice Axis
symbols.description: Two restrained markers record the extreme seasonal paths of the sun without turning the plaza into a literal observatory.

symbols.name: Equinox Axis
symbols.description: Paired inlays mark the equal division of day and night and provide the composition with a precise east-west reference.

symbols.name: Lemniscate of Continuity
symbols.description: The raised infinity form represents knowledge repeatedly revised, preserved, and returned to public study.

symbols.name: Timeline of Disciplines
symbols.description: A sparse sequence of dates records the fictional founding of Blackwood faculties from rhetoric and astronomy to computation.

symbols.name: Knowledge Network
symbols.description: Constellation-like pins connect fields that share methods, instruments, and archives rather than presenting knowledge as isolated departments.

symbols.name: Celestial Rosette
symbols.description: Seshat's restrained radial headpiece combines a star, compass divisions, and calibrated observation marks.

sceneModes.label: Museum White
sceneModes.description: An isolated architectural-visualization setting with neutral studio illumination and clean contact shadows.

sceneModes.label: Overcast Courtyard
sceneModes.description: Cool diffuse daylight, wet paving, restrained moss, and historic university facades behind the monument.

sceneModes.label: Rainy Night
sceneModes.description: Blue-grey rain, warm academic windows, dark reflections, low mist, and restrained amber monument lighting.

cameraPresets.label: Hero View
cameraPresets.description: Frames Seshat, the infinity sculpture, orbital ring, floating approach, and basin reflections together.

cameraPresets.label: Low Angle
cameraPresets.description: Emphasizes the raised infinity sculpture, cantilevered plinth, ring, and strong vertical geometry.

cameraPresets.label: Top Down
cameraPresets.description: Reveals the radial channels, split basin, coordinate axes, scientific alignments, and floating platforms.

cameraPresets.label: Side Profile
cameraPresets.description: Shows the asymmetrical plinth, thin water sheets, structural ring supports, and statue balance.

restorationModes.label: Maintained Weathering
restorationModes.description: Shows prestigious but rain-exposed materials with patina, mineral deposits, moss, scratches, and moisture masks.

restorationModes.label: Newly Commissioned
restorationModes.description: Suppresses most patina and staining while retaining the material differences and engraved construction.

restorationModes.label: Restoration Comparison
restorationModes.description: Places a clean conservation reference beside the weathered original for direct material and silhouette inspection.

performance.waterTechnique: single bounded procedural mirror-water shader plus instanced channels, sheets, residual drips, and quality-scaled ripple motion
